filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. The Arabic coverage is strong for most topics, featuring popular channels like Code Masry and Adel Nasim. One Arabic topic, 'Heapsort: O(n) Build Heap Time Complexity Analysis', required using the view count exception to select a highly relevant but low-view video. No suitable Arabic video could be found for 'Insertion Sort: Loop Invariants and Correctness Proof' as all candidates failed either the relevance or hard gates.
